text:
rachel: quick heads-up: encountered an odd parity between JS and Python SDKs for jsonMode + function_call helpers. JS path lets a double-encoded string slip through and downstream code treats it as a valid object.

rachel: repro (minimal):
```js
await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-instruct-1.0', jsonMode: true, function_call: { name: 'create_user', arguments_schema: userSchema }, input: prompt })
// model returns object, but JS helper + retry -> final payload becomes '"{\"name\":\"x\"}"' (string)
```

sasha: that sounds like the retry wrapper stringifies helper results after helper processing. py parses earlier and keeps as object. which SDK versions?

rachel: js@2.4.1, py@1.10.2, samplekit v0.25. stack trace shows helper.parse() -> helper.validate() -> return -> retry.serialize() -> retry retries with string.

kevin: we've seen a similar double-encode in older retry wrapper changes. Two immediate fixes: parseBeforeRetry (parse & validate before retry serialization) OR change retry to replay the original model call only and not reserialize helper outputs.

diane: also noticed sample templates set coerceTypes=true by default. That makes JS helper coerce numeric values into strings which then match loose enum checks. python rejects. so two parity problems intersect here.

sasha: agreed. proposal: 1) change samplekit scaffolds to set coerceTypes=false when jsonMode=true, 2) add parseBeforeRetry behavior in JS helper runner, 3) add strictEnums flag (opt-in) and a lint warning when coerceTypes + jsonMode are both true.

kevin: implemented a small patch: parseBeforeRetry + unit tests asserting typeof helperResult === 'object' before any retry serialization. also tightened default schema in sample template to object-only where appropriate. will open PR.

rachel: can you add an integration test that simulates model emitting numbers for enum fields (e.g., 2) and asserts validation fails when strictEnums is enabled? We had a production hit where priority=2 passed silently.

kevin: yes. adding integration that runs the sample helper through the full generate/retry flow and asserts parse errors bubble up (no permissive array fallback).

sasha: let's also add a short docs blurb and changelog note: "When using jsonMode with function_call helpers, prefer strict type validation (strictEnums / coerceTypes=false) and enable parseBeforeRetry to avoid double-encoding issues."

ci-bot: CI: samplekit/integration fncall-jsonmode matrix failed on node12 in run 7901; linked logs https://ci.internal/7901

diane: i'll pick up the scaffold lint and docs. label thread devex:fncall-json and move to triage.

kevin: PR opened, tests added, will ping here once CI green.

rachel: thanks everyone. I'll re-run the broken sample-app after green and follow up if anything else crops up.
